medmemo.title: Desktop AI Chat and Health Memory Application
medmemo.kicker: Built MedMemo with Go, Wails, and React/TypeScript to combine AI conversations, health records, and memory retrieval in a desktop application.
medmemo.caption: Go backend, React/TypeScript interface, conversational memory, and model integration.
medmemo.memoryBody: Working, short-term, and long-term memory layers.
medmemo.licenseBody: Open-source software under the MIT license.
medmemo.takeawayTitle: Connected chat, memory, and desktop workflows
medmemo.takeawayBody: As the primary developer, built the Go backend and React interface, integrated model providers and memory retrieval, and worked on testing and desktop packaging.
medmemo.feature1Body: Integrated SQLite/SQLCipher and local retrieval components to store conversations and retrieve relevant health information.
medmemo.feature2Body: Implemented working, short-term, and long-term memory with vector and keyword search so earlier information can be recalled during later conversations.
medmemo.feature3Body: Integrated OpenAI-compatible APIs and local model providers with streaming responses and summary compression to manage conversation context.
medmemo.feature4Body: Added memory and privacy workflow tests and fixed Windows library packaging and CI configuration to support repeatable builds.
medmemo.proofTitle: Go application layers and replaceable integrations
medmemo.proofIntro: Organized domain logic, use cases, repository interfaces, and model adapters with Clean Architecture and Google Wire.
medmemo.stack1Body: Wails, Go, React, TypeScript, Zustand, and desktop packaging.
medmemo.stack2Body: Clean Architecture, Google Wire, domain entities, use cases, repositories, and adapters.
medmemo.stack3Body: Model providers, ONNX Runtime, embeddings, sqlite-vec, and memory retrieval.
medmemo.safetyBody: MedMemo is a health information management and consultation-assistance tool. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions, or medical decisions.
medmemo.stackBody: Go backend and React/TypeScript interface connected through Wails bindings.
medmemo.desktopBody: Desktop application framework and build tooling.

jobcopilot.title: AI Resume Processing and Job Matching Platform
jobcopilot.kicker: Contributed to a React, Spring Boot, and FastAPI platform connecting resume processing, semantic matching, AI chat, and application tracking.
jobcopilot.caption: Semantic retrieval, asynchronous AI workflows, and containerized services.
jobcopilot.runtimeBody: Main application runtimes: React frontend, Spring Boot backend, and Python AI service.
jobcopilot.vectorBody: Semantic search foundation for resume and job matching.
jobcopilot.licenseBody: Open-source software under the MIT license.
jobcopilot.takeawayTitle: Connected resume data with AI workflows
jobcopilot.takeawayBody: As a major contributor and maintainer, developed backend and AI service integrations for resume processing, job matching, chat, and application tracking.
jobcopilot.feature1Body: Connected upload, parsing, versioning, editing, and export through REST APIs so resume content can move between the interface and AI services.
jobcopilot.feature2Body: Integrated PostgreSQL/pgvector retrieval to compare resume content with job descriptions and support AI-assisted matching.
jobcopilot.feature3Body: Used RabbitMQ workers and Redis coordination to separate long-running AI tasks from user-facing API workflows.
jobcopilot.feature4Body: Supported Docker Compose and Nginx configuration to connect the frontend, backend, AI services, database, cache, and queue through a shared gateway.
jobcopilot.proofTitle: Backend domains and AI service boundaries
jobcopilot.proofIntro: Worked with domain-driven backend modules, REST interfaces, message queues, and vector storage to connect application workflows with AI services.
jobcopilot.stack1Body: React, TypeScript, Nginx, multilingual interfaces, authentication, resume management, chat, and application tracking.
jobcopilot.stack2Body: Java 25, Spring Boot, DDD, hexagonal architecture, Maven modules, REST controllers, and application services.
jobcopilot.stack3Body: Python, FastAPI, LiteLLM, embeddings, resume/job parsing, RabbitMQ consumers, Redis, and MinIO model artifacts.
jobcopilot.stackBody: Java/Spring Boot backend and Python/FastAPI AI services.
jobcopilot.resultBody: Fixed resume editing by triggering vector generation after the database transaction commits, keeping external AI calls outside the transaction boundary.
